## aw-app-proxy
Route the Kali desktop's automation Chromium through this workspace's own aw-app-proxy, the same way aw-app-browser already does. The tool owns persisting this setting inside the Kali container itself — flipping it kills and relaunches the automation browser, picking up the new setting immediately; no restart of this container is needed.

widgets.label: Route Chrome through aw-app-proxy
widgets.offline_text: The Kali container is off — start it below to change this setting.
